rag.text:
Test: TC-4729 — Global - Gadget - Risks - Adding gadget to Jira dashboard for Root box
Priority: High | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-162 Global - Gadget
Labels: teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Overview module of root box
   Expected: Overview module is presented with root box
2. Click the "More actions" ellipsis
   Expected: A list of actions is opened
3. Choose Configure option
   Expected: Box configuration page is opened
4. On the General section choose Modules
   Expected: List of Modules appear
5. Activate Risks module
   Expected: Risks module is activated, toggle button is setup on green
6. Expand Dashboards menu on the top and Create dashboard with dashboardName
   Data: dashboardName: Adding Risks gadget to Jira dashboard for Root box
   Expected: New Dashboard is created
7. In Search gadgets field provide gadgetName and add gadget
   Data: gadgetName: Risks
   Expected: Risks gadget is added to dashboard. 

Entering configuration gadget screen appear. Default Box  is Home, Height -400px, Refresh interval - Never.
8. Save default configuration
   Expected: Risks gadget show Matrix cell of Root box with risk data
